title: Cops Take Down ‘Drunk Cowboy’ Twice In One Week
description:
A Kentucky man is facing numerous charges after allegedly fleeing police on a mule and acting erratically in a bar days earlier. Police took Jonathan Mason, 39, into custody after a caller reported him allegedly cracking a whip inside a restaurant and bothering patrons. When police arrived Mason can be seen on bodycam video holding onto a mule saying he was "leaving," but it wouldn’t be that easy for the 39-year-old. Two days later, police received another call about Mason allegedly riding the mule while intoxicated. When police approached him, however, the suspect took off on the mule leading police on a short chase before he was apprehended.   Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
